correctness.rationale: All 245025 row-column restrictions are covered. For all minor sizes at most four, the nonzero cyclotomic norm is a positive integer of modulus at most 4^8=65536, so reduction at a primitive 12th root modulo either checked prime greater than 65536 preserves vanishing exactly. Separately coded Python and C++ finite-field eliminations over distinct primes agree on the exhaustive counts (0,1224,39384,204417). Python also constructs the complete 21-class affine partition and checks every member has the displayed row-profile. The displayed table has 21 correctly aligned five-column rows. No extrapolation or tolerance is used.
